extras: Keyboard-first design, full offline help system, and export capabilities to CSV, JSON, or iCalendar.
intentEvidence: Vertex Flow turns your vault into a fast, high-density project management OS — no cloud, no account, no database.
motivation: To provide a fast, high-density project management system where all data remains locally stored in plain Markdown files, ensuring user data ownership.
problem: Users often rely on proprietary, cloud-based task managers that lock data outside the local file system and lack keyboard-driven efficiency.
summary: A keyboard-first task manager that stores projects, tasks, and dashboards entirely as plain Markdown notes within the vault.
